resources.string: Only taps the [Clear cache] button in the Settings app for you. It does not read or store other screens and sends nothing off your device.
• Opens Settings > Apps > Storage and taps [Clear cache] for you.\n• Uses \"Usage access\" to show how much cache each app has.\n• Needs the \"Accessibility\" permission to do this.
What this app does not do
• It does not look at any screen other than Settings.\n• It does not store screen content or send it anywhere.\n• It never deletes app data (logins, photos, settings) — only cache.
While it works, you can stop at any time with the [Stop] button at the top of the screen.
Permission 1 below is needed to show cache sizes.
